subject: Recap & next steps — capacity, unit economics, and blended pricing for Sentinel.ai
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@sentinel.ai>
Cc: Tom Berger <tberger@sentinel.ai>
Date: Sun, 7 Feb 2027 16:10:00 -0800
Subject: Recap & next steps — capacity, unit economics, and blended pricing for Sentinel.ai

Hi Elena / Tom,

Thanks again for taking time today — great conversation. Quick recap and a short list of asks so we can put a concrete pricing summary together: 

Recap from our call:
- Current pilot traffic: ~3M tokens/month across two customer-facing routes (responses + embeddings).
- Target expansion: production rollout across 3 product teams with spikes up to ~25M tokens/month in peak months.
- SLA/compliance: SOC2 required, data residency in us-east for production.
- Latency target: 90th percentile < 400ms for short-form responses.

What we need from you to model unit economics and propose a blended rate: 
1) Monthly volume bands you expect over the next 6–12 months (rough bands are fine; e.g., 1–5M, 5–15M, 15–30M).
2) Target budget or an acceptable $/1M tokens range (helps us shape step-up discounts).
3) Any routes or models you intend to add at launch beyond responses+embeddings (e.g., reranking, long-document summarization).
4) Procurement timeline / approvals and any hard renewal/commitment windows.

Action: I attached our latest pricing workbook (redwood_pricing_v2.xlsx) with sample blended calculations and a separate SOC2 evidence link you requested. If you can send the rough volume bands and target $/1M by EOD Tuesday PST, Ben and Karthik will model a few step-up options and we’ll propose a 3- and 6-month commitment structure.

Next suggested touchpoints:
- Internal pricing run: Wed (we’ll prepare options)
- Joint pricing review: Thu or Fri next week (15-30 min)

Thanks — happy to hop back on a short call if that helps.

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0194
[Attachment: redwood_pricing_v2.xlsx]

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@sentinel.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Berger <tberger@sentinel.ai>
Date: Mon, 8 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps — capacity, unit economics, and blended pricing for Sentinel.ai

Monica — thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers below. I copied Tom for procurement visibility.

1) Volume bands (rough, monthly):
- Months 1–2 (pilot expansion): 4–6M tokens
- Months 3–6 (initial production): 10–18M tokens
- Months 7–12 (growth): 20–28M tokens, with occasional peaks to 35M during promotions

2) Target economics: our procurement lead asked for an initial target of $700–$1,000 per 1M tokens committed. If the blended rate is outside that range we’ll need a clear case on improved latency or reliability to justify.

3) Routes/models to add:
- rerank route (for search results)
- long-summarize (long-form doc summarization) — likely a higher token per request profile

4) Procurement timeline: we’d like to close commercial terms within 4 weeks; legal will need standard DPAs and SOC2 evidence (I attached a checklist).

We can meet Thu 10am PT for the joint pricing review. Please confirm.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Head of Platform Engineering | Sentinel.ai
elena.rossi@sentinel.ai
[Attachment: sentinel_requirements_SOC2.pdf]

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Cc: Tom Berger <tberger@sentinel.ai>
Date: Mon, 8 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Recap & next steps — capacity, unit economics, and blended pricing for Sentinel.ai

Ben / Karthik — forwarding Elena’s reply (volume bands + target $/1M = $700–$1,000).

Asks for modeling: can you run 3 blended scenarios for the bands below and include cost/latency trade-offs? Please prioritize production route mix that includes: responses, embeddings, rerank, long-summarize.

Scenario A (conservative): months 3–6 average 10M/mo; steady-state 20M/mo
Scenario B (base): months 3–6 average 14M/mo; steady-state 24M/mo
Scenario C (aggressive): months 3–6 average 18M/mo; steady-state 30M/mo with 35M peak allowance

Key outputs I need back by EOD Wed:
- Blended $/1M tokens per scenario (3 bands + blended)
- Recommended initial commitment (months + token commit) and step-up schedule
- Whether adding long-summarize should be priced at a premium or covered by a blended uplift
- Any hard blockers for SOC2/residency we need to flag

I’ll coordinate the Thurs 10am PT slot for the joint pricing review once you confirm.

Thanks,
Monica

[Attachment: redwood_pricing_v2.xlsx]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Feb 2027 11:24:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Recap & next steps — capacity, unit economics, and blended pricing for Sentinel.ai

Thanks for the context — ran the numbers quickly and sketched three routable options. High level first, then attached a summary sheet.

High level recommendations:
- Offer a 6-month stepped commitment with quarterly step-ups to hit target utilization; include a 10% burst buffer for peaks.
- Blended unit economics should be presented as a per-1M token blended rate across the customer’s route mix (responses, embeddings, rerank, long-summarize).

Proposed blended rates (per 1M tokens) by scenario — includes recommended route mix and small premium for long-summarize (x1.3 multiplier):
- Scenario A (conservative): 1–5M band: $1,050; 5–15M band: $920; 15–30M band: $830; blended: $950
- Scenario B (base): 1–5M band: $1,000; 5–15M band: $880; 15–30M band: $780; blended: $860
- Scenario C (aggressive): 1–5M band: $980; 5–15M band: $840; 15–30M band: $720; blended: $800

Notes on premium and routes:
- Long-summarize: recommend premium vs standard response due to longer context and GPU memory pressure; we applied a 1.3x uplift in the blended examples. If Sentinel commits to a minimum % of long-summarize traffic, we can fold it into the blended base at a smaller uplift.
- Rerank: low token per request but high QPS — treat as throughput-sensitive. No material premium in $/1M but drives concurrency requirements.

Commitment structure suggestion:
- 6-month initial term with soft commit: minimum average of 10M tokens/month (month 1–2 ramp), then step to customer-targeted bands each quarter.
- If Sentinel signs a 12-month committed contract, we can push blended numbers ~5–8% lower across bands.

Next steps I’ll take:
- Put the numbers into the pricing workbook and mark assumptions (attached).
- Draft an initial commercial term language for commitments and burst allowances for legal/procurement.

If that blended $/1M for Scenario B (~$860) lands within their stated $700–$1,000 target we should be in a good spot for a quick close. Recommend we confirm Thurs 10am PT for the joint review and have procurement on the call.

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0122
[Attachment: redwood_pricing_v2_sentinel_summary.xlsx]
